question: Sylvan Primordial destroys target noncreature permanents and then searches for a Forest for each one destroyed. Do I search and shuffle my library separately for each permanent?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you search and shuffle your library only once.
expected.answer: You search and shuffle your library only once.
